From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps

Hi Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned:

- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization across product docs and support tickets (multi-tenant).
- Key constraints: sub-150ms p95 latency for short queries, strict data residency in US, and SOC2 evidence required.
- Expected monthly volume: ~6M tokens (spiky during launches).

Next steps I mentioned on the call: I'll put together a short pricing estimate and a recommended config (model + quantization + autoscaling guidance) and send by EOD tomorrow. Lauren will join any technical walkthroughs if helpful.

If I missed anything critical, please reply or DM. Otherwise I'll send the estimate tomorrow.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Alex — attaching the pricing estimate and one-page config deck we discussed. High level:

- Recommended plan: Dedicated small GPU pool with prefix caching + 2x burst nodes for peak traffic.
- Estimated monthly cost (model + infra): $9,500 — includes 99.9% uptime SLA and monthly usage report.
- Typical lead time for Dedicated: 2–3 weeks after contract.

I'm happy to walk through the deck and the cost assumptions — would a 20-minute call tomorrow or Thursday afternoon work? If you prefer, I can also send a one-page summary for procurement.

Please confirm receipt when you get a sec.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
